item.title: AI Tools Can Improve Accuracy in Chest Radiograph Reporting
item.description: AI-prefilled structured reporting improves diagnostic accuracy in chest radiograph reporting compared with free-text reporting, a 2026 prospective reader study has found. The post AI Tools Can Improve Accuracy in Chest Radiograph Reporting appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Triple-Site Ovarian Cancer Recurrence Managed Robotically
item.description: Robotic secondary cytoreductive surgery enabled rapid complete removal of three extrapelvic ovarian cancer recurrences in one case. The post Triple-Site Ovarian Cancer Recurrence Managed Robotically appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Rheumatology Podiatry Service Expands Access to Public Foot Care
item.description: A rheumatology podiatry service trial will test feasibility of improving patient-centered foot outcomes in rheumatologic disorders. The post Rheumatology Podiatry Service Expands Access to Public Foot Care appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: MASLD Overlap Shapes Symptom Burden in PSC
item.description: New data suggest MASLD overlap alters pruritus and fatigue severity in primary sclerosing cholangitis, with implications for symptom monitoring in hepatology practice. The post MASLD Overlap Shapes Symptom Burden in PSC appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Climate Change Is Fuelling the AMR Crisis
item.description: Rising temperatures are increasing antimicrobial resistance deaths in the Western Pacific, highlighting urgent need for global coordinated action. The post Climate Change Is Fuelling the AMR Crisis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Digital Morphology Distinguishes Mixed Odontogenic Tumours
item.description: Quantitative digital pathology revealed distinct morphometric features among mixed odontogenic tumors, suggesting virtual cell analysis may aid diagnosis when conventional histology is inconclusive. The post Digital Morphology Distinguishes Mixed Odontogenic Tumours appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Reveal the Brain Pathways Disrupted in Dyslexia
item.description: Dyslexia may stem from vulnerable brain networks rather than single genes, offering new insight into diagnosis and intervention. The post Scientists Reveal the Brain Pathways Disrupted in Dyslexia appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: tRNA Fragment Shown to Protect Skin Against Photoageing
item.description: New research identifies a tRNA-derived RNA fragment that protects skin from UV-induced photoageing by preserving collagen and stabilising key mRNAs. The post tRNA Fragment Shown to Protect Skin Against Photoageing appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Bayer launches global women’s health campaign
item.description: Bayer and VML Health have launched a campaign challenging the tendency to normalise pain in women's health. The post Bayer launches global women’s health campaign appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Psychotic Experiences May Cause Early Brain Ageing
item.description: New research links psychotic experiences to early brain ageing, offering clues about psychosis risk in young adults. The post Psychotic Experiences May Cause Early Brain Ageing appeared first on European Medical Journal.
